---
title: "Generate a Repository"
doc-type: how-to
---

Use this guide when you know the Downstream Repository you want and need to choose its template, harnesses, profiles, and skills.

## Discover Available Choices

Start with the executable catalogs rather than a copied inventory:

```bash
uv run python -m repo_familiar list-templates
uv run python -m repo_familiar list-agent-harnesses
uv run python -m repo_familiar catalog model
uv run python -m repo_familiar catalog tool
uv run python -m repo_familiar describe tool cq
uv run python -m repo_familiar list-skills
```

The default new-repository template is `python-reproducible`. Select `basic` for a generic repository or `static-quarto-application` for the opt-in Quarto client and FastAPI application boundary. See [Templates](../reference/templates.qmd) for the stable distinctions.

## Preview A Selection

Repeat profile and skill flags to include multiple choices:

```bash
uv run python -m repo_familiar generate \
  --name "Demo Project" \
  --description "A generated demo." \
  --output /path/to/demo-project \
  --template python-reproducible \
  --agent-harness opencode \
  --agent-harness paseo \
  --model-profile default-coding \
  --tool-profile cq \
  --memory-profile memory-local \
  --skill cq \
  --skill session-focus \
  --dry-run
```

Review the planned paths and selected options. Generation refuses a non-empty output directory unless `--force` is supplied; use `--force` only for known generated output such as a deterministic example refresh.

## Write And Verify

Remove `--dry-run` after the preview matches the intended shape, then verify the result:

```bash
uv run python -m repo_familiar check --path /path/to/demo-project
```

Bootstrap Metadata records selected profile names and generated assets. Exact profile definitions stay in generated `.agents/*.yml` files; secrets and machine-level harness configuration remain user-owned.

## Use Interactive Selection

Run the same flow through `questionary` prompts:

```bash
uv sync
uv run python -m repo_familiar generate --interactive
```

For all flags and metadata fields, use [CLI and Metadata Reference](../reference/cli-and-metadata.qmd). For command ownership and write behavior, use [Bootstrap Lifecycle](../reference/bootstrap-lifecycle.qmd).
